messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi! I’d like to return some items I bought recently. I’ve decided to stop gaming and want to cancel or return everything related to it. Can you help me with that?

Yes—I can help with a return, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **the email address** you used to place the order.  
(If you don’t want to share email, tell me your **first name, last name, and ZIP code** instead.)

Also, if you have it handy, share the **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`) so I can confirm the items and whether the order is eligible for return.
Sure! The email I used is mia.garcia2723@example.com. I don’t have the order ID with me right now, but I can provide more details if needed.

Thanks, Mia—I found your account (**mia_garcia_4516**). You currently have these orders:

- **#W5490111**
- **#W7387996**

To return “everything related to it,” I’ll need to confirm which order you mean.

**Please tell me the order ID** you want to return (either **#W5490111** or **#W7387996**).  
If you’re not sure, tell me roughly when you bought it or what gaming items you purchased, and I can help identify the right one.

Once you choose the order, I’ll also ask which items you want to return and which **payment method** you want the refund to go to (original **PayPal** or **credit card**, or a **gift card** if you have one).

I’m not sure about the order number, but I bought the gaming items pretty recently—within the last month, I think. If you could check which order has the gaming stuff, that would be great. And I’d prefer the refund to go back to my original payment method.
